text_zh: 百搭又顯氣色，日常必備色！我黃調肌用起來完全不挑膚色。
text_en: So versatile and brightens my complexion. My yellow undertone loves this shade.
author: Emily K.

text_zh: 抹上去很滋潤不會乾，顏色一天都不會掉太多。
text_en: Moisturizing and lasts all day.
author: Cathy L.

text_zh: 珊瑚粉很春夏，秋冬會太亮，看個人喜好。
text_en: Coral works better for spring/summer looks.
author: Zoe P.

text_zh: 可可豆沙超好看，配大地眼影絕搭！
text_en: Cocoa Kiss pairs perfectly with warm eye looks.
author: Amber W.

text_zh: 顏色偏冷，我暖膚色擦起來有點怪。
text_en: Too cool-toned for my warm complexion.
author: Jane H.

text_zh: 蜜桃紅超顯氣色！亞洲肌必買。
text_en: Peach Glow brightens any complexion. Must-have for Asian skin.
author: Yuki T.

text_zh: 貂毛刷質感很好，粉體細膩不飛粉。
text_en: Mink brush feels luxurious, powder is finely milled.
author: Linda M.

text_zh: 杏桃奶茶色我最愛！超級日常。
text_en: Apricot Tea is my daily go-to.
author: Sophia R.

text_zh: 中性色配得剛剛好，霧面基底粉質細膩不飛粉。
text_en: Well-balanced neutral shades. Mattes are silky, not chalky.
author: Grace L.

text_zh: 亮片會有點掉，但顯色度很好。
text_en: Slight fallout on glitters but pigmentation is great.
author: Chloe H.

text_zh: 大地色超適合亞洲膚色！焦糖色我畫過最好的一盤。
text_en: Perfect for Asian skin. Caramel shade is exceptional.
author: Mia S.

text_zh: 赤陶跟可可色配起來秋天感十足。
text_en: Terracotta + cocoa = perfect fall look.
author: Nora C.

text_zh: 毛流感眉超自然，我畫成癮！
text_en: Natural hair-stroke definition, I use it daily.
author: Vicky W.

text_zh: 防水但拔下來也不會刺激。
text_en: Waterproof but gentle to remove.
author: Han Y.

text_zh: 睫毛量瞬間 3 倍！刷頭好用。
text_en: 3x volume instantly. Brush is genius.
author: Vivian T.

text_zh: Y20 剛好合我的黃調肌，光澤感真的漂亮。
text_en: Y20 matches my yellow undertone perfectly. Beautiful glow.
author: Ellie K.

text_zh: 妝感自然、8 小時不脫妝真的做到了。
text_en: Natural finish and truly 8-hour wear.
author: Sarah C.

text_zh: 皮膚敏感我用了完全沒過敏，很好。
text_en: My sensitive skin had no reaction. Great!
author: Bella J.

text_zh: 很光澤但油肌可能會太亮，我需要控油粉。
text_en: Glowy finish, oily skin may need a setting powder.
author: Julia F.

text_zh: 帶著補妝超方便！SPF 也夠用。
text_en: Great for touch-ups, SPF is a bonus.
author: Nina L.

text_zh: 有替換蕊很棒，長期算下來 CP 值高。
text_en: Refillable design saves money long-term.
author: Peggy H.

text_zh: 遮黑眼圈超有力，質地很滑順不卡紋。
text_en: Covers dark circles well without creasing.
author: Diana W.

text_zh: 痘痘遮起來看不出來，但要少量疊擦。
text_en: Covers blemishes with layered application.
author: Kate M.

text_zh: 禮盒送閨蜜她超愛！包裝質感也很棒。
text_en: Perfect gift for a girlfriend. Beautiful packaging.
author: Mandy L.

text_zh: 第一次入手 LUNA 就選禮盒，可以一次試三個明星商品。
text_en: Great intro to LUNA — try 3 hero products at once.
author: Rita S.
